steps.headline: News: headlines by topic from the sites you pick, as a built-in Page you can pin.
steps.hint: Click Pages (grid button in the top bar), then News under Built in. Try Topics and sources, Show 3 more, and the pin on the News row.
steps.notice: Builder's main gaps: nowhere says a built-in Page is a place a feature can live; no spot for a whole-screen tool button; "date bottom right" adds dead space on grid cards; first-run card's filled button competes with Pages' own filled Create a page.
steps.risk: Stories are made up; clicking one would open the real site.
